title: Sister Haze
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A hazy TR-808 groove in A minor opens with lone sine tones before layering in a warm sine bassline and delicate triangle chord stabs. The full chorus thickens with a running sine-wave melody that occasionally leaps an octave, riding over a steady four-on-the-floor kick and open hats.
